title: Exact finite second-order defect for the PAH-OMC-020 semigroup lift
question: At the R-493 stabilization threshold, does the unchanged PAH-001 generator identity survive one further generator application for a declared grade-blind cylinder, or is the finite semigroup lift already obstructed at second order?

exact_scope.model: The exact finite strip/root implementation used by PAH-OMC-013, with PAH-001 F_rho, all declared directed roots, midpoint rate exp(-Delta F/2), beta=nu=1 and external stochastic Markov time.
exact_scope.time: The generator time is the external stochastic Markov time declared in PAH-001; it is not quantum real time, proper time or Lorentzian time.
exact_scope.pair: coarse n=3 and fine n+1=4, with R_max=1 and the source sample_state(4,3); the R-493 cylinder is f=ell_(0,0).
exact_scope.operator: D_(2)=L_4^2 I_(3,4)f - I_(3,4)L_3^2 f, evaluated pointwise at the preregistered fine state.
exact_scope.first_order: The same witness satisfies L_4 I f - I L_3 f=0 exactly, so the defect is not a first-order mismatch.
exact_scope.scope_boundary: This is one exact finite-state counterexample to promoting the support-dependent R-493 first-order identity to a fixed-pair finite semigroup identity. It is not a universal no-go for every separately authorized refinement map or every observable.

witness.state_definition: PAH-OMC-013 sample_state(4,3), followed by the unchanged neutral coordinate projection to level 3

source_boundary.R-493_threshold: R-493 uses N(f)=max(2,m_f+1); for ell_a its declared m_f is 2 and the witness uses n=N(f)=3.
source_boundary.no_model_change: The calculation uses the original PAH-001 functional, mobility, directed roots, finite counting state and external stochastic time without a counterterm, mixture, fitted rate or new carrier.

exact_finding.interpretation: The local first-order intertwining at its registered threshold does not provide the all-iterate closure required by the finite matrix-exponential semigroup identity.

acceptance.primary: Reconstruct exact affected-term energy deltas, Q(sqrt(2)) mobility coefficients and exponential-polynomial generator compositions from the frozen implementation; match the four-term residual oracle and certify its factorized sign.
acceptance.independent: Recompute the same witness using direct full-energy numerical transitions and an independent nested generator implementation; verify first-order zero and second-order negative residual without importing the primary residual polynomial.
acceptance.hostile: Reject any n<N(f) witness, any changed rate or functional, any source-state mixture, any derivative-only inference, and any report that promotes this route-local finite obstruction to PAH-OMC-020, continuum, QFT or physical claims.
acceptance.lean: Prove the exact polynomial factorization x+x^2-1-x^3=-(x-1)^2(x+1) and its strict negative sign at x=exp(1/3)>1 under the pinned Lean toolchain.

missing_assumptions: A separately source-authorized invariant subspace or all-function operator identity could still support a different finite semigroup route; this witness does not supply or refute such a successor map.
The ordered j-before-anchored-n common-space, path-space, R-512 identification and uniform-limit inputs remain absent.
finding: The exact unchanged PAH witness has zero first-order R-493 defect at n=N(f), but a strictly negative second-order residual. Therefore R-493's support-dependent pointwise identity cannot be exponentiated into the asserted fixed-pair semigroup intertwining on this grade-blind cylinder.
non_claims: No PAH-OMC-020 ordered j-before-anchored-n semigroup convergence is proved or universally refuted.
No common infinite-volume process, path law, closable operator, continuum limit or R-512 identification follows.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, event-horizon, gravity, QFT, Yang--Mills, mass-gap, cosmic-origin or TOE conclusion follows.
Markov time remains the external stochastic time declared by PAH-001 and is not quantum real time, proper time or Lorentzian time.
